Initializes the editor's plain JavaScript modules, concatenated in a fixed order. It first requests the namespace tree to determine [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][authentication]] state, then starts secondary loads; function details load on demand. A 401 opens sign-in. See the [[file:../../../docs/EDITOR_MODULES.md][module map]].

Indexes downloaded function, [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]], [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][binding]], and list-item rows for client rendering. Maps such as ~fnMap~ and ~bindingByFnSlot~ replace repeated scans of the same arrays. Because writes rebuild these lookups, their cost affects editor refresh latency.

* 4. fetchBackendLayout
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: editor/fetchBackendLayout
:FILE: resources/packages/app/editor/editor-layout.js
:LINE: 307
:MINS: 10.2
:END:

Requests grid layout from ~/api/graph/layout~ using the selected root and expansion state. The browser then measures cards and edge labels to calculate column widths and gaps. The server determines graph order; the browser fits that order to actual pixel sizes.

Coordinates one asynchronous render. A generation counter prevents an older render from replacing a newer one; a remembered anchor preserves the user's position while data loads. After applying layout changes, it measures [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][DOM]] cards and adjusts positions to their actual sizes.

Builds an absolutely positioned HTML function card; edges are separate SVG elements. The card contains inherited levels, a use-site heading for expanded references, and [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]] rows. These controls present the stored function/[[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]]/[[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][binding]] model for editing.

* 7. bindActionDispatch
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: editor/bindActionDispatch
:FILE: resources/packages/web/runtime/graphden-runtime.js
:LINE: 78
:MINS: 2.1
:END:

Registers one delegated event listener on a host and resolves ~data-action~ through the action-handler registry. Newly inserted server fragments become interactive without individual listener registration. Registering the listener once prevents repeated openings of a reused popover from executing the same action multiple times.

:PROPERTIES:

:LINE: 122
:MINS: 5.0

Orders function-picker candidates without accessing the [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][DOM]] or network. Exact-name matches come first, followed by namespace groups and compatibility/fit ranking. Typed searches show all matches; browsing can fold groups. The server's ~candidate-fit~ in the Web block supplies fit metadata without changing type admissibility.

:FILE: resources/packages/app/editor/editor-edit-modes.js
:LINE: 226
:MINS: 7.1

Asks ~/api/value-form~ for a widget appropriate to the [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slot]], then dispatches by ~data-form-widget~. The client does not choose the widget from raw type tags. After saving, it reloads [[file:glossary.org::#term/binding][bindings]] and lookups because changing a value changes stored graph rows.

Loads grouped differences for a selected comparison branch. Explorer badges, canvas highlights, field changes, [[file:glossary.org::#term/effect][effect]] changes, and review comments use this data; comparison-only functions appear as additional display rows. Reads and edits still target the current branch. The comparison menu provides review and merge actions.

:MINS: 1.6

Applies a validated theme payload as inline CSS custom properties on the body. The sanitizer permits known tokens and supported color values, rejecting injected declarations or URLs. A localStorage copy applies before first paint; saved server preferences reconcile afterward. See [[file:../../../docs/MARKETPLACE.md][themes]].

* 15. authFetch
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: editor/authFetch
:FILE: resources/packages/app/editor/editor-auth.js
:LINE: 108
:MINS: 1.2
:END:

Sends authenticated editor requests and handles 401 by clearing the stored credential and opening sign-in. HTTP 4xx responses still resolve normally: callers must inspect the response status. A ~try/catch~ alone detects network exceptions, not rejected HTTP writes.
